user.title: Škola OnLine — Marks
user.description: Enter the login for your Škola OnLine parent account. It is used only to read marks — nothing is changed in the school system.

children.title: Children to track
children.description: Select which children found on this account should be tracked. If a child wasn't found automatically, add it manually below as "studentId:Name" (comma-separated for more than one) — the list of children on a parent account is not fully documented by Škola OnLine's API, so this fallback exists in case auto-detection is incomplete.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate Škola OnLine
reauth_confirm.description: The login for account "{username}" is no longer valid. Enter the current password to continue.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to Škola OnLine.
error.no_students_selected: Select or manually add at least one child.

children.title: Children to track
children.description: Select which children found on this account should be tracked, or add one manually.

data.marks_per_subject: Marks kept per subject in attributes

data_description.update_interval_minutes: How often to poll Škola OnLine for new marks.
data_description.marks_per_subject: How many of the most recent marks per subject are kept in the sensor attributes. Older marks are still available on demand via the get_marks service.

abort.cannot_connect: Could not connect to Škola OnLine.

get_marks.name: Get marks
get_marks.description: Fetch the complete list of marks for a child (and optionally a semester/subject) fresh from Škola OnLine — used for the "show more" action in the marks card, since sensor attributes only keep a short recent list.

semester_id.description: Leave empty for the current semester.
